findings.evidence: dom-1440.json: 13 slide images have alt="" (the first five, e.g. e20y1cmsstuxxzr4jb0wzn3zgyp31epmj.jpeg, which carry text such as 'Find and Contact the People You Need Through...'), and 26 have only 'LinkedIn Series B Pitch Deck to Greylock: Slide N'. The numbering is also off by one (Slide06.jpg is labelled 'Slide 5'). The slides are the subject of the essay and are images of text.
findings.before: alt="" / alt="LinkedIn Series B Pitch Deck to Greylock: Slide 5"
findings.after: alt="Slide 6: [the slide's headline and key bullets as written]", or a visually hidden transcript of each slide's text beneath it; fix the off-by-one numbering.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.1.1 Non-text Content and 1.4.5 Images of Text: a screen-reader user cannot follow commentary about slides whose text is unavailable.
